recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個中型淋巴球核呈多葉花瓣狀（flower cell，A），流式顯示 CD7 缺失、CD4 陽性的 T 細胞族群（B）；組織切片在心肌、軟組織與淋巴結內可見糞小桿線蟲（Strongyloides）幼蟲（C–E），符合 HTLV-1 相關 ATLL 合併播散性糞小桿線蟲感染。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with deeply lobulated, clover-leaf (flower) nucleus, condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm (A)
Flow cytometry: CD3-positive T-cell population with loss of CD7 (arrowhead) and CD4-positive, CD8-negative phenotype (B)
Slender filariform larva lying between cardiac myocytes (C)
Coiled nematode larva within fibrous/soft tissue with mild inflammatory reaction (D)
Lymph node at low power with a larva (arrowhead, inset) in the capsule/sinus region (E)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical medium-sized lymphocyte with a markedly lobulated, flower-like nucleus and condensed chromatin. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD3-positive, CD4-positive, CD8-negative T-cell population with loss of CD7. Tissue sections (heart, soft tissue and lymph node) contain slender nematode larvae with minimal surrounding inflammation, morphologically consistent with Strongyloides stercoralis filariform larvae. Findings are consistent with HTLV-1-associated adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with disseminated strongyloidiasis (hyperinfection); HTLV-1 serology and CD25 expression support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than polylobated flower nuclei, and HTLV-1 is negative.
Prolymphocytes have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, usually retain strong CD7, and carry TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive atypical lymphocytes with lobulated nuclei
ddx.vs: Reactive cells are polyclonal with preserved pan-T-cell antigens (including CD7) and do not show a clonal CD4+/CD25+ HTLV-1-positive population.

ddx.dx: Other tissue nematodes (e.g., hookworm, Trichinella larvae)
ddx.vs: Trichinella encysts within skeletal myocytes and hookworm larvae do not typically disseminate to heart and lymph nodes in the immunosuppressed; Strongyloides hyperinfection is the classic HTLV-1 association.
